[ARC CHARTER] u--9s2 Phase-2 increment 2.3 — team coordination home (the team cannot see u-- tickets; this stoa-- ticket is their home). Owner: Polybius_the_Stoa (user-tier forge domain), SUPERVISING; reports up to Polybius the Grand at u--9s2.

DELIVERABLE (the WHAT; the HOW is the CHIRON+HAMILTON design folded into the build): the runnable PROVISIONING CHOREOGRAPHY — the builder-deploy skill, design-formal section 4 S0-S6 (S0 isolation scaffold per-builder GCP project+SA+budget -> S1 API enablement -> S2 secret slots [S2c human gate] -> S3 Railway db+serving -> S4 DB extensions -> S5 agent-access-layer SHAPE mesh-API+CLI-client -> S6 verify), generalizing newswire-builder-setup + reusing railway-keyring-deploy + credential-discipline. Consumes the 2.1 resolved set (+ 2.2 SUGGEST); EMITS a value-free per-builder provisioning spec. Plus the human-in-the-loop credential-acquisition choreography (agent drives browser to the edge -> clickable link to a browser the agent cannot see -> deploy-help patterns).

TWO HARD BOUNDARIES: (1) TRIPWIRE — 2.3 builds+tests against MOCK/throwaway/dry-run ONLY; if any step would touch REAL infra/creds/money, STOP and surface to Polybius_the_Stoa who flags Grand FIRST; the real provisioning is 2.4 (scienceclaw). (2) CREDENTIAL-DISCIPLINE — no agent holds credential VALUES; emit value-free specs (slot names); the applier is CI-via-WIF or a human one-shot (railway-keyring-deploy: OS keyring -> CLI via ENV/STDIN, never agent stdout/argv/disk); per-builder GCP project + prepaid card = the hard spend cap.

RELAY-UP DELIVERABLES (Grand single gate REQUIRES): (a) the PROVISIONING CHECKLIST — exactly what PRINCIPAL provisions (per-builder GCP project + prepaid card + billing + Railway + Tailscale), step+when; (b) the credential-discipline ATTESTATION; (c) the TRIPWIRE-HELD attestation (zero real infra/creds/money in the build/test).

RESOLVE/FOLD: (1) the permanent builder-deploy HOME (deferred from 2.1, stoa--wmu; a near consumer exists now) — CHIRON proposes, Polybius_the_Stoa ratifies; (2) stoa--jd5 (pyproject package-data glob, the 2.3 packaging prerequisite); (3) the mock/dry-run substrate so the DoD is machine-checkable AND the TRIPWIRE is structurally honored.

CHAIN: PRINCIPAL -> Polybius the Grand -> Polybius_the_Stoa (supervising) -> POLYBIUS_the-stoa FM -> PLINY_the-stoa -> CHIRON+HAMILTON design (folded into the build) -> full gauntlet DAEDALUS-ARGUS-ADA-VERA-CATO-NOMOS. COMPOSITION: custom-agent+workflow (FM + PLINY + MAJOR_CHIRON + MAJOR_HAMILTON). ONE PASS (Grand process change 2026-06-27: design folded into the build, no separate design-gate; relay the COMPLETE increment for a single gate). Gauntlet REQUIRED, no waiver. DOGFOOD the liveness fix: record seats on spawn + WRITE STAND-DOWN on close (the registry was found stale-lying). Full directive attached at attachments/stoa--k48/u9s2-phase2-inc3-directive.md. — Polybius_the_Stoa | sid 990b0750-5572-4836-b9c7-18d626a12e96 | the-stoa
